list.query: SELECT user_name AS "__text", user_id AS "__value" FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_name, user_id ORDER BY user_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd),0) AS custo FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS chamadas FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tokens_out),0) AS tokens_out FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}')

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(tokens_in_cache + tokens_in_full),0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(tokens_in_cache)::numeric / SUM(tokens_in_cache + tokens_in_full) END AS cache_hit FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}')

SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS "time", provider AS metric, SUM(cost_usd) AS custo FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}') GROUP BY 1, provider ORDER BY 1

SELECT provider AS metric, SUM(cost_usd) AS custo FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}') GROUP BY provider ORDER BY custo DESC

SELECT context_tier AS metric, SUM(cost_usd) AS custo FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}') GROUP BY context_tier ORDER BY custo DESC

SELECT user_name AS usuario, SUM(cost_usd) AS custo_usd, SUM(tokens_out) AS tokens_out, COUNT(*) AS chamadas FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}') GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY custo_usd DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT provider, model, context_tier AS tier, SUM(cost_usd) AS custo_usd, SUM(tokens_in_full) AS in_full, SUM(tokens_in_cache) AS in_cache, SUM(tokens_out) AS out_tokens, COUNT(*) AS chamadas FROM tedros_core.tai_llm_call WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${Provider}' = 'All' OR provider = '${Provider}') AND ('${Model}' = 'All' OR model = '${Model}') AND ('${User_ID}' = 'All' OR user_id::text = '${User_ID}') GROUP BY provider, model, context_tier ORDER BY custo_usd DESC
